defaults.setup: Install exact lockstep core, CLI, and MCP candidate tarballs and start breakdown-mcp with no project selected.
defaults.action: Drive the real stdio JSON-RPC process with the indexed protocol/client fixture and observe frames, values, effects, and lifecycle.

rows.oracle: Packed manifest/bin/engine/version inspection shows a local stdio executable in exact release lockstep.
Initialize and tools/list return exact cataloged identity, supported protocols, and six-tool operation order.
Every tool has the exact read-only/idempotent/destructive/open-world annotation tuple from the catalog.
Capability discovery and requests prove every cataloged forbidden capability absent.
Each tool schema is the strict projected operation variant with required version/root and no additional properties.
Startup touches no project; missing, relative, URI, cwd, environment, workspace, repository, and Roots-derived selections fail.
Structured content equals the one compact text block exactly and preserves core data/failure with correct isError.
Malformed protocol requests produce JSON-RPC errors while expected operation failures stay successful tool-call envelopes.
Cancellation/closure aborts core work, sends no cancelled response, and preserves exact commit-or-no-commit inspection recovery.
Stdout contains only one JSON-RPC frame per line, stderr stays sanitized/bounded, and EOF/signals leave no daemon.
Both protocols, Inspector, wrapper and independent client, schemas, forbidden surfaces, errors, cancellation, and lifecycle cases pass.
MCP-only and mixed CLI/MCP shared traces preserve exact values, failures, ordering, limits, and Run bytes.
